description: Synthetic Telnyx Voice API webhook scenarios for Phase 5b call forwarding. These fixtures document event order and expected side effects; real Telnyx signatures are intentionally omitted.

scenarios.name: forwarding_on_dial_bridge
expected: bridge inbound to owner with play_ringtone=true

scenarios.name: owner_timeout_no_answer
events: call.hangup owner leg hangup_cause=timeout before call.bridged

scenarios.name: owner_decline_or_busy
events: call.hangup owner leg hangup_cause=user_busy before call.bridged

scenarios.name: dial_or_bridge_error
events: Telnyx dial or bridge command throws
expected: best-effort hangup for any live leg

scenarios.name: duplicate_fallback_event
events: call.hangup owner leg duplicate or retry
expected: second event observes fallback already claimed

scenarios.name: caller_abandons_while_owner_ringing
expected: hang up/cancel owner leg so the owner's phone stops ringing

scenarios.name: recording_error_existing_path
expected: do not use forwarding attempt state
